story.title: Mass Protests Erupt in Iraqi Kurdistan Against Baghdad's Oil Control Plans
story.summary: Thousands of protesters gathered in Irbil, the capital of Iraq's Kurdish region, opposing the federal government's plans to take control of oil operations and border crossings. Demonstrators waved flags and expressed their discontent over the potential centralization of resources that have historically been managed by the Kurdish authorities.

timeline_highlights.title: Anthropic Launches Record IPO, Valued at $1.5 Trillion on Nasdaq
timeline_highlights.summary: Anthropic has begun trading on the Nasdaq following a record initial public offering (IPO) that raised approximately $81.3 billion. This valuation positions the AI company at around $1.5 trillion, surpassing SpaceX's previous record of $75 billion. Despite concerns about market volatility and public sentiment towards AI, the company's shares surged upon debut.
key_facts: Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its IPO.
The company's valuation reached approximately $1.5 trillion.
Shares debuted at around $98 each.

timeline_highlights.title: Protests Erupt in Belgium Against Austerity Measures Amid Rising Living Costs
timeline_highlights.summary: On November 23, 2026, thousands of workers marched in Brussels to protest proposed austerity measures as Belgium's government faced challenges in finalizing its budget for 2027. The demonstrations turned confrontational, leading police to use tear gas and water cannons to disperse crowds.

timeline_highlights.title: Thousands Protest in Athens Over Rising Living Costs
timeline_highlights.summary: On November 25, 2026, approximately 14,000 people marched in Athens as part of a 24-hour strike against rising living costs and stagnant wages. The industrial action led to significant disruptions, including halted metro services, grounded flights, and ferries remaining in port.

related_stories.title: Two Italians Killed in Iranian Drone Attack in Kuwait, Iran Denies Involvement
related_stories.summary: An Iranian drone attack on a military facility in Kuwait resulted in the deaths of two Italian workers and injuries to four others. The victims were technicians employed by a German company. Iran has denied any involvement in the incident, which has drawn international attention.

related_stories.title: Trump Calls for Putin to Reduce Military Aggression in Europe
related_stories.summary: US President Donald Trump stated that he urged Russian President Vladimir Putin to reduce military aggression in Europe. He expressed optimism about the potential for a quick deal between Russia and Ukraine to prevent further escalation of the conflict. Trump shared his comments on his Truth Social account but did not clarify what he meant by 'territories throughout Europe.'

related_stories.title: Diesel Tanker Capsizes Off Ibiza, One Crew Member Dies
related_stories.summary: A Maltese-flagged diesel tanker carrying approximately 7,000 tonnes of fuel capsized off the coast of Ibiza. While all 17 crew members were rescued, one later died in the hospital. Spanish authorities are now implementing a contingency plan to address potential marine pollution risks.
